description: Framing edge cases every SDK's SSE reader must decode identically, whatever the stream. A block dispatches a frame when it carried any field (even an id alone or an unknown field), so readers skip empty-data frames after advancing their resume cursor. A trailing block without its closing blank line is discarded, never flushed.

vectors.name: unterminated-tail-discarded
vectors.note: the stream ended mid-frame; only complete frames are delivered

vectors.name: id-only-block
vectors.note: dispatches an empty-data frame; readers advance the cursor to 5 and deliver nothing

vectors.name: keepalive-comment
vectors.note: the 20s `: ka` comment is not a frame

vectors.name: multi-line-data
vectors.note: data lines join with a single newline
vectors.wire:
data: line one
data: line two

vectors.name: colon-spacing
vectors.note: exactly one leading space after the colon is removed
